historical_selection_source.selection_objective: unweighted macro mean of transition-level census NDCG@5

metric.name: canonical positive-relevance NDCG@5
metric.tie_handling: canonical deterministic seeded jitter with sorted ticker order

regime_definition.definition: Regime of each transition is determined by the feature window W_t. Annualized volatility is population std of daily FF5 mkt_rf times sqrt(252). LOW/MED/HIGH use the 33.3 and 66.7 percentiles across all 20 feature/target windows H1--W7.

configuration.return_path: row-L2-normalized standardized FF5 residual-return path in W_t
configuration.target_window_text: never loaded for eligibility or features

tfidf_frozen.refit_policy: vocabulary and IDF refit separately on each feature-time corpus; hyperparameters frozen

configuration.universe: returns in W_t and W_{t+1}; non-empty source=10K vintage Item 1 text filed strictly before W_t start only

limitations: Historical window artifacts use the repository's fixed current-survivor cohort rather than a point-in-time listing master.
Regime labels are descriptive full-sample volatility terciles, not a deployable ex-ante regime classifier.
Adjacent transitions share boundaries and are not independent; the exact sign-test calculation is therefore anti-conservative.

comparison.sign_test_note: Exact binomial calculation; adjacent-window dependence makes the independence interpretation anti-conservative.
